description: National Water Prediction Service is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Water Prediction Service. View predicted flood status at gauges across the United States. Click to zoom in on a region and roll your cursor over gauge markers to read location names. Click markers of interest to view hydrographs showing recent and forecast discharge levels. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
